abstract: This study investigates how audit firm-level spatial licensing requirements affect audit market competition and audit quality, focusing on small (triennially inspected) audit firms, for which licensing frictions are most relevant. Exploiting the staggered state-level adoption of CPA firm mobility provisions that remove spatial licensing barriers, we find that adoption increases competition among small audit firms, as reflected by lower market concentration and greater first-time entry by small out-of-state auditors. Firm mobility adoption also improves audit quality, as indicated by a lower likelihood of client misstatements. These effects are concentrated in less competitive audit markets and among auditors with higher PCAOB deficiency rates. Audit quality improvements extend to both incumbent auditors and new out-of-state entrants, and we find no evidence of audit fee discounting. Overall, our results suggest that removing spatial licensing barriers fosters a more competitive small audit firm market while improving audit outcomes, without increasing audit costs.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了审计事务所层面的空间执业许可要求如何影响审计市场竞争与审计质量，重点关注小型（每三年接受检查的）审计事务所，因为许可摩擦对其影响最为显著。利用各州分阶段采纳注册会计师事务所流动性条款（该条款消除了空间执业壁垒）这一自然实验，我们发现，此类条款的采纳增强了小型审计事务所之间的竞争，表现为市场集中度降低以及小型外州审计师首次进入市场的频率增加。事务所流动性条款的采纳还提升了审计质量，表现为客户错报可能性降低。这些效应在竞争程度较低的审计市场以及PCAOB缺陷率较高的审计师中更为突出。审计质量的提升同时惠及现有审计师和新进入的外州审计师，且未发现审计费用折价现象。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，消除空间执业壁垒促进了小型审计事务所市场的竞争性增强，同时改善了审计结果，且未增加审计成本。

title: The consequences of audit firm mobility for attestation services across states

abstract: We examine whether negative news media coverage of peer audit firms affects audit quality by mitigating the contagion effect of low-quality audits. We find that when a company issues a restatement, other companies served by the same audit office or within the same city are more likely to subsequently issue a restatement. However, we find that higher negative peer firm news coverage mitigates this contagion effect, particularly when auditors have greater opportunity to improve audit quality (smaller companies) and when media attention amplifies reputational pressures (higher local news intensity). Our findings extend to litigation-related news but not to nonnegative news, suggesting that auditors respond to perceived reputational threats stemming from negative news. Additionally, negative peer news increases auditor attention, consistent with an auditor supply-side effect that improves audit quality. Our findings highlight the media’s role as an informal oversight mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了同行审计事务所的负面新闻媒体报道是否通过缓解低质量审计的传染效应来影响审计质量。研究发现，当一家公司发布重述时，由同一审计办公室或同一城市服务的其他公司随后更有可能发布重述。然而，我们发现，同行公司负面新闻报道的增加缓解了这一传染效应，尤其是在审计师有更大机会提升审计质量（规模较小的公司）以及媒体关注放大声誉压力（当地新闻强度较高）的情况下。我们的研究结果扩展到与诉讼相关的新闻，但不适用于非负面新闻，这表明审计师对负面新闻引发的声誉威胁感知作出反应。此外，同行负面新闻增加了审计师的关注度，这与审计师供给侧效应提升审计质量相一致。我们的发现凸显了媒体作为非正式监督机制的作用。

title: Does news media affect audit quality? Evidence from variation in the “contagion effect”
title_zh: 新闻媒体会影响审计质量吗？——基于“传染效应”变化的证据

abstract: We examine whether U.S. media sentiment on foreign countries influences domestic investors’ international asset allocation. Using flows to country-specific mutual funds as a proxy for investor demand, we find that negative media sentiment, measured by the interaction of negative tone and media attention given to foreign countries, is strongly associated with reduced investor flows into funds targeting those countries. This relationship is driven, at least in part, by media sentiment that is unrelated to the economic fundamentals of the targeted countries. We employ The Wall Street Journal’s acquisition by News Corp to support the causal interpretation of our findings. Our results highlight the perception-shaping role of media narratives in driving global investment decisions. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: L. Ma acknowledges funding support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72103008]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504 .

abstract: We use career backgrounds of initial employees from a full cohort of U.S. startups to measure founding teams’ skillsets. Startups with more diverse prior industry experience grow faster than same-industry local peers. One-standard-deviation-higher diversity is associated with 16% (10%) higher five-year employment (sales) growth, controlling for demographic diversity, prestartup wages, and other observables. Startups in innovative industries and facing lower coordination costs among team members drive the results. To address endogeneity, we exploit shocks in which teams suddenly lose members with unduplicated skills. Overall, combining individual specialization with team-level diversification allows teams to act as “jacks of all trades and masters of each.” This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Sloan Foundation. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773 .
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国初创企业完整队列中初始员工的职业背景来衡量创始团队的技能组合。拥有更多元化先前行业经验的初创企业，其增长速度超过同行业本地同行。在控制人口统计多样性、创业前工资及其他可观测因素后，多样性每增加一个标准差，五年期就业（销售）增长率分别提高16%（10%）。这一效应在创新行业及团队成员间协调成本较低的初创企业中更为显著。为解决内生性问题，我们利用团队突然失去拥有不可复制技能成员的冲击。总体而言，将个人专业化与团队层面多元化相结合，使团队能够成为“多面手且各有所长”。本文由金融学编辑Bo Becker接受。资助：本研究使用人口普查局纵向雇主-家庭动态项目的数据，该项目部分得到国家科学基金会[资助号SES-9978093、SES-0339191和ITR-0427889]、国家老龄化研究所[资助号AG018854]及阿尔弗雷德·P·斯隆基金会资助。补充材料：网络附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773获取。

abstract: We investigate the heritability of risk, uncertainty, and time preferences using a large-scale field experiment with adult twins, complemented by a comprehensive meta-analysis of prior studies. Our research introduces a novel empirical approach that integrates behavioral genetics with structural econometrics, enabling us to directly quantify the heritability of latent preference parameters in behavioral models of decision making, without relying on observed proxies. Our incentive-compatible experiment is the first to simultaneously elicit all three types of preferences within the same individuals in a twin study. Our findings reveal a stronger genetic influence on risk and uncertainty preferences than previously reported. We demonstrate that conventional proxy measures for preferences and simplified structural models tend to overstate the influence of unique environmental factors. These results help contextualize preference heterogeneity as a driver of persistent differences in decision making across individuals, leaders, and organizations. This paper was accepted by Aurélien Baillon, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: Support from the University of Technology Sydney and from the Australian Government through the Australian Research Council’s Centre of Excellence for Children and Families over the Life Course [Project IDs CE140100027 and CE200100025] is gratefully acknowledged. This research was facilitated through access to Twins Research Australia, a national resource supported by the National Health & Medical Research Council since 1981, administered by the University of Melbourne. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669 .
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项针对成年双胞胎的大规模实地实验，结合对先前研究的全面元分析，探讨了风险偏好、不确定性偏好和时间偏好的遗传性。我们的研究引入了一种新颖的实证方法，将行为遗传学与结构计量经济学相结合，使我们能够直接量化行为决策模型中潜在偏好参数的遗传性，而无需依赖观察到的代理指标。我们的激励相容实验是首个在同卵双胞胎研究中同时引出所有三种偏好的实验。我们的发现表明，风险与不确定性偏好的遗传影响比先前报道的更强。我们证明，传统的偏好代理测量方法和简化结构模型往往高估了独特环境因素的影响。这些结果有助于将偏好异质性作为个体、领导者和组织间决策持久差异的驱动因素进行情境化理解。本文已被行为经济学与决策分析领域的编辑Aurélien Baillon接受。资金支持：感谢悉尼科技大学和澳大利亚政府通过澳大利亚研究委员会“儿童与家庭生命周期卓越中心”项目（项目编号CE140100027和CE200100025）提供的支持。本研究得以进行得益于澳大利亚双胞胎研究资源的访问，该资源自1981年以来由澳大利亚国家健康与医学研究委员会支持，由墨尔本大学管理。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669获取。

abstract: The design of online algorithms for matching markets and revenue management settings is usually bound by the assumption that the demand process is formed by a fixed-length sequence of queries with unknown types, each drawn independently. This notion of serial independence implies that the demand of each type, that is, the number of queries of a given type, has low variance and is approximately Poisson distributed. This paper proposes a nonparametric framework for modeling arrival sequences in online stochastic matching that departs from the serial independent assumption. We propose two models, Indep and Correl, that capture different forms of serial correlations by combining a nonparametric distribution for the demand with standard assumptions on the arrival patterns: adversarial or random order. The Indep model can capture arbitrary serial correlations within each customer type but assumes cross-sectional independence across types, whereas the Correl model captures common shocks across customer types. We demonstrate that fluid relaxations, which rely solely on demand expectations, have arbitrarily bad performance guarantees. In contrast, we develop new algorithms that achieve optimal (constant factor) performance guarantees in each model. Our mathematical analysis includes tighter linear programming (LP) relaxations that leverage distribution knowledge and a new lossless randomized LP rounding scheme for Indep. We test our new LP relaxations and rounding scheme in simulations on real and synthetic data and find that they consistently outperform well-established matching algorithms, especially on real data sequences that exhibit greater demand variance. This paper was accepted by Itai Ashlagi, revenue management and market analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424 .
abstract_zh: 在线匹配市场和收益管理环境中在线算法的设计通常受制于一个假设，即需求过程由一系列固定长度的查询构成，这些查询的类型未知且各自独立抽取。这种序列独立的概念意味着每种类型的需求，即给定类型的查询数量，具有低方差且近似服从泊松分布。本文提出了一种非参数框架，用于建模在线随机匹配中的到达序列，该框架偏离了序列独立的假设。我们提出了两个模型，Indep和Correl，通过将需求的非参数分布与到达模式的标准假设（对抗性或随机顺序）相结合，捕捉不同形式的序列相关性。Indep模型可以捕捉每种客户类型内的任意序列相关性，但假设跨类型截面独立，而Correl模型则捕捉跨客户类型的共同冲击。我们证明，仅依赖需求期望的流体松弛具有任意差的性能保证。相比之下，我们开发了新算法，在每个模型中实现了最优（常数因子）性能保证。我们的数学分析包括利用分布知识的更紧的线性规划（LP）松弛，以及针对Indep的一种新的无损随机LP舍入方案。我们在真实和合成数据上通过模拟测试了我们的新LP松弛和舍入方案，发现它们始终优于成熟的匹配算法，尤其是在表现出更大需求方差的真实数据序列上。本文由Itai Ashlagi接受，属于收益管理和市场分析领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424获取。

abstract: The effect of demographic diversity on teamwork remains theoretically ambiguous. More diverse teams may benefit from more creativity and knowledge sharing, but they also face higher communication and coordination costs. This paper tests these competing mechanisms in the context of higher education. We exploit an experimental setting in a large undergraduate class, where students are randomly assigned to small homework groups, with varying levels of diversity in terms of race, gender, and place of birth. We find that the relationship between diversity and performance depends systematically on the task environment: more diverse groups outperform less diverse groups in open-ended, generative tasks, but underperform in more structured analytical tasks. We then address the effect of team diversity on coordination and communication, building an index of teamwork quality based on collaboration between members, the balance of member contributions, and the absence of conflicts. We find that diversity has a U-shaped effect on teamwork quality, regardless of the type of task performed. This result suggests that faultlines – dividing lines that split a group into subgroups based on demographic characteristics – can cause inter-subgroup cohesion to break down, while very homogeneous or very heterogeneous groups collaborate better. The results help provide a framework to understand optimal team composition for institutions and organizations.
abstract_zh: 人口多样性的影响在理论上对团队合作仍存在不确定性。更多样化的团队可能因创造力和知识共享的增加而受益，但也面临更高的沟通与协调成本。本文在高等教育背景下检验了这些相互竞争的机制。我们利用一个大班本科课程中的实验设置，学生被随机分配到小型作业小组，这些小组在种族、性别和出生地方面具有不同程度的多样性。我们发现，多样性与绩效之间的关系系统地依赖于任务环境：在开放式、生成性任务中，更多样化的群体表现优于较少多样化的群体，但在结构化的分析性任务中则表现不佳。接着，我们探讨了团队多样性对协调与沟通的影响，基于成员间的合作、成员贡献的均衡性以及冲突的缺失构建了一个团队合作质量指数。我们发现，无论执行何种类型的任务，多样性对团队合作质量的影响呈U形。这一结果表明，断层线——根据人口特征将群体划分为子群体的分界线——可能导致子群体间凝聚力瓦解，而高度同质或高度异质的群体则合作得更好。这些结果有助于为机构和组织理解最优团队构成提供一个框架。

title: Diversity in teams: Collaboration and performance in experiments with different tasks

abstract: We report the results from a large field experiment that tests if happiness spreads within an organizational setting, as predicted by the emotional contagion hypothesis. Although some studies have supported this hypothesis, no well-powered randomized controlled trial has ever tested it in the field. In collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces, we randomly assign over 1500 recruits to rooms during eight-week boot camps. Some recruits live with relatively happier peers while others live with relatively unhappier ones. We find no evidence of happiness convergence at the room level and reject even small contagion effects. We show that the null result is not explained by excessive stability in happiness, and prior studies in the same setting show that peer effects emerge for some non-emotional attitudes. These results call for a reconsideration of the presumed ubiquity of happiness spillovers, with subsequent implications for well-being models and policies.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项大规模实地实验的结果，该实验检验了情绪传染假说所预测的幸福感是否能在组织环境中传播。尽管已有一些研究支持这一假说，但尚无一项具有充分统计功效的随机对照试验在实地环境中对其进行验证。我们与挪威武装部队合作，在为期八周的新兵训练营中，将超过1500名新兵随机分配到不同房间。部分新兵与相对更快乐的同伴同住，而另一些则与相对不那么快乐的同伴同住。我们发现，在房间层面没有证据表明幸福感趋于一致，甚至拒绝了微小的传染效应。我们证明，这一零结果并非由幸福感的过度稳定性所解释，且在同一环境下的先前研究表明，同伴效应确实会对某些非情绪态度产生影响。这些结果呼吁重新审视幸福感溢出效应被假定为普遍存在的观点，并对幸福感模型及政策制定具有后续启示。

title: Does happiness spread within organizations? Evidence from a field experiment in Norway
title_zh: 幸福感会在组织内部传播吗？来自挪威实地实验的证据

abstract: We study how firm-level carbon emissions affect bank lending and real outcomes in a sample of global firms with syndicated loans. We exploit bank-level climate commitments as firm-level shocks to lending relationships, using firms' prior credit exposures to identify credit supply effects. Firms with higher emissions that previously borrowed from committed banks receive less bank credit. Evidence from lending volumes, prices, and within-firm-time loan-level data indicates a supply-side shift away from high-emission firms, not explained by borrower risk. Affected firms reduce debt, leverage, size, and investment, yet we find no reduction in future emissions, instead documenting evidence consistent with greenwashing. (JEL G21, G23, G30, D62, Q50)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在全球拥有银团贷款的企业样本中，企业层面的碳排放如何影响银行贷款及实际经营结果。我们利用银行层面的气候承诺作为企业层面贷款关系的冲击，通过企业以往的信贷敞口来识别信贷供给效应。先前从有承诺的银行借款的高排放企业，获得的银行信贷减少。来自贷款规模、价格以及企业-时间层面贷款数据的证据表明，信贷供给正从高排放企业转移，且这一现象并非由借款人风险解释。受影响的企业减少了债务、杠杆、规模和投资，但我们未发现其未来排放有所减少，反而记录了与“漂绿”行为一致的证据。(JEL G21, G23, G30, D62, Q50)
title: Carbon Emissions and the Bank-Lending Channel
title_zh: 碳排放与银行信贷渠道

abstract: We study the term structure of default-free interest rates in a sticky-price model with an occasionally binding effective lower bound (ELB) constraint on interest rates and recursive preferences. The ELB constraint induces state-dependency in the dynamics of term premiums by affecting macroeconomic uncertainty and interest-rate sensitivity to economic activities. In a model calibrated to match key features of the aggregate economy and term structure dynamics in the U.S. above and at the ELB, we find that the ELB constraint typically lowers the absolute size of term premiums at the ELB and increases their volatility around the time of liftoff. The central bank's announcement to keep the policy rate at the ELB for longer than previously expected lowers the expected short rate path, but its effect on term premiums depends on the risk exposure of bonds to the macroeconomy; while the announcement increases term premiums if bonds are a hedge against economic downturns, it decreases them otherwise.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个校准的DSGE模型，其中短期名义利率面临偶尔约束的有效下界（ELB），该模型匹配了美国宏观经济和利率期限结构的关键特征。我们表明，ELB约束通过影响宏观经济不确定性和利率对经济活动的敏感度，引发期限溢价的态依赖性，通常降低期限溢价的绝对规模，并在接近ELB时产生独特的动态变化。在ELB处，中央银行的前瞻指引降低了预期短期利率路径，但根据需求冲击或供给冲击的主导地位，期限溢价可能增加或减少。
title: Equilibrium Yield Curves and the Interest Rate Lower Bound
title_zh: 均衡收益率曲线与利率下限

abstract: Digital distribution has expanded monetization opportunities for media firms, but it also introduces complex tradeoffs across channels. A central challenge for studios and networks is negotiating fixed-fee licensing deals with bundled subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) platforms like Netflix, whose flat-rate access model may cannibalize à la carte sales on transactional platforms such as iTunes. We exploit the natural experiment of Netflix’s launch in Australia to estimate the causal effect of licensing a film to the service on its digital sales. On average, licensing reduces à la carte downloads by 52.5%, with effects that persist even after titles are removed from Netflix – evidence that temporary bundling can have durable effects on competing transactional channels. Crucially, we show that this treatment effect is heterogeneous: the direction and magnitude of the effect vary systematically with a film’s à la carte price and its latent demand. Lower-priced titles exhibit positive treatment effects following Netflix inclusion while higher-priced titles experience substantial declines, consistent with a framework in which subscriber substitution and cross-segment exposure operate in opposite directions and are differently moderated by the à la carte price. Our findings offer rare revealed-preference evidence on how SVOD bundling interacts with underlying demand, addressing classic questions in industrial organization around bundling and channel conflict.
abstract_zh: 数字发行扩大了媒体公司的变现机会，但也带来了跨渠道的复杂权衡。制片厂和电视网络面临的一个核心挑战是如何与Netflix等捆绑式订阅视频点播（SVOD）平台谈判固定费用许可协议，因为这类平台的包月访问模式可能会蚕食iTunes等交易型平台上的单点销售。我们利用Netflix在澳大利亚上线的自然实验，估计将电影授权给该服务对其数字销售的因果效应。平均而言，授权使单点下载量减少52.5%，且这一效应在影片从Netflix下架后依然持续——这表明临时捆绑可能对竞争性交易渠道产生持久影响。关键在于，我们证明这一处理效应具有异质性：效应的方向和大小随影片的单点价格及其潜在需求系统性变化。价格较低的影片在纳入Netflix后呈现正向处理效应，而价格较高的影片则出现显著下滑，这与一个框架相一致，即订阅者替代和跨细分市场曝光以相反方向发挥作用，并受到单点价格的不同调节。我们的发现提供了罕见的显示性偏好证据，说明SVOD捆绑如何与潜在需求相互作用，回应了产业组织领域关于捆绑和渠道冲突的经典问题。
title: Netflix and Chilling Effect? The Impact of Streaming Video Licenses on Paid Digital Downloads
title_zh: 奈飞与寒蝉效应？流媒体视频许可对付费数字下载的影响

abstract: We examine the effect of local public charging infrastructure on electric vehicle (EV) adoption using microdata from Norway between 2010 and 2023. We use million new car registrations, geocoded to buyers’ residences and matched to nearby charging stations, along with individual- and neighbourhood-level controls and fixed effects, to estimate the causal impact of local charger availability. We find statistically significant, but economically negligible effects: doubling charger density in 2023 increases the probability of EV adoption by less than 1 percentage point. Of the (74 percentage-point) increase in the EV share in new registrations from 2016 to 2023, less than one percentage point is explained by new publicly available chargers. Effects are heterogeneous, and largely driven by car buyers living in multi-dwelling housing, and those residing in large urban areas.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2010年至2023年间挪威的微观数据，考察了本地公共充电基础设施对电动汽车（EV）普及的影响。我们使用了百万条新车注册记录，这些记录按购买者居住地进行地理编码，并与附近的充电站相匹配，同时结合个人及社区层面的控制变量和固定效应，来估计本地充电设施可用性的因果效应。我们发现，虽然统计上显著，但经济效应微乎其微：到2023年，充电桩密度翻倍仅使电动汽车普及概率增加不到1个百分点。在2016年至2023年间新车注册中电动汽车份额（上升74个百分点）的增长中，不到1个百分点可归因于新增的公共充电设施。效应存在异质性，且主要由居住在多户住宅及大城市地区的购车者驱动。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Local charger availability and electric vehicle adoption: Evidence from Norway
title_zh: 本地充电桩可用性与电动汽车普及：来自挪威的证据

abstract: Low-emission zones (LEZs) increase commuting costs by car but decrease negative traffic externalities in affected locations. High-income workers are more likely to sort into central locations where the benefits of the policy are expected to be the strongest, but are also more likely to commute by car. Thus, they should be more exposed to both the costs and benefits of driving restrictions. Using a quantitative urban model with rich worker heterogeneity and non-homothetic preferences, I argue that the redistributive effects of urban policies are indeed shaped by these differences in exposure and budget shares. After showing that the model is able to reproduce the patterns of sorting across space and transport modes observed in the Greater Paris region, I use it to compute the prospective effects of the Parisian LEZ. Results indicate that the policy would most likely increase welfare only at the top of the income distribution, while the rest of the population would suffer net losses.
abstract_zh: 低排放区（LEZs）提高了驾车通勤成本，但减少了受影响地区的负面交通外部性。高收入工人更可能选择居住在城市中心区域，那里预期政策收益最大，但他们也更倾向于驾车通勤。因此，他们应同时面临驾驶限制带来的成本与收益。利用一个包含丰富工人异质性和非齐次偏好的定量城市模型，我认为城市政策的再分配效应确实受到这些暴露程度和预算份额差异的影响。在证明该模型能够再现大巴黎地区观察到的空间与交通方式选择模式后，我运用它来预测巴黎低排放区的潜在影响。结果表明，该政策最可能仅提高收入分配顶端群体的福利，而其余人口将遭受净损失。
title: The redistributive effects of transport policies
title_zh: 交通政策的再分配效应

abstract: Unsustainable land-use change has become an increasingly critical social and environmental issue. Over a few decades, vast expanses of land with native vegetation or devoted to mixed-farming systems have given way to large-scale agriculture, incurring considerable biodiversity and livelihood loss. Cattle ranching and the production of a handful of internationally traded commodities such as soy and palm oil play a pivotal role in that expansion. They have led to numerous sustainability initiatives to curb their negative social and environmental impacts, yet a “supply chain” framing poses important limitations, for it typically fails to consider relationships between sectors and broader landscape dynamics. For one, there may be much stronger drivers than food consumption at play. This article draws from the frontier literature and explores the concept of “vanishing mediator” to analyze the role played by cattle ranching in particular. Comparing the Brazilian and Colombian Amazon, we assess how ranching intermediates an ongoing transition between pre-frontier forest areas and capital-intensive monocultures. We draw from land-use data and the scientific literature on each of the two cases as well as on a total of 30 key-informant interviews done in Brazil and Colombia. Our results show that cattle ranching’s role in spearheading deforestation in both countries cannot be understood without reference to its broader context, for it works as a vanishing mediator between pre-frontier settings and industrial agriculture. Ranching occupies frontiers with little infrastructure, paving the way for monocultures; it is instrumental to the land grabbing that makes the endeavor highly profitable; and, crucially, it precariously absorbs and co-opts displaced smallholders. Cattle ranching introduces the latter — as well as incoming settlers — to state institutions that previously neglected them and to a market-driven approach to land use that still preserves the trappings of rural living. Ultimately, however, people migrate to sprawling cities and clear the way for capital-intensive crops such as soy in Brazil and oil palm in Colombia. We conclude that the notion of individualized “supply chains” is shortsighted for dealing with such broader dynamics. Instead, effective sustainability interventions require addressing local vulnerabilities and investing in economic alternatives that can successfully hedge against deforestation drivers.
abstract_zh: 不可持续的土地利用变化已成为日益严峻的社会与环境问题。数十年来，大片原生植被覆盖或用于混合农业系统的土地被大规模农业所取代，造成了显著的生物多样性丧失和生计损失。养牛业以及大豆、棕榈油等少数国际贸易商品的生产在这一扩张中扮演了关键角色。这些活动催生了众多旨在遏制其负面社会与环境影响的可持续性倡议，然而，“供应链”框架存在重大局限，因为它通常未能考虑部门之间的关系及更广泛的景观动态。例如，可能存在着比食品消费更为强大的驱动因素。本文借鉴前沿文献，探讨“消逝的中介”这一概念，以分析养牛业所扮演的特殊角色。通过比较巴西亚马孙与哥伦比亚亚马孙，我们评估了养牛业如何在前沿森林地区与资本密集型单一作物种植之间的持续转型中发挥中介作用。我们利用土地利用数据、针对这两个案例的科学研究文献，以及在巴西和哥伦比亚进行的共30次关键知情人访谈。研究结果表明，若不参照更广泛的背景，就无法理解养牛业在两国带头推动毁林中的作用，因为它在前沿地带与工业化农业之间充当着消逝的中介。养牛业占据基础设施匮乏的前沿地区，为单一作物种植铺平道路；它有助于土地掠夺，使这一活动高度有利可图；并且至关重要的是，它不稳定地吸纳并同化了被边缘化的小农。养牛业将后者——以及新来的定居者——引入此前忽视他们的国家机构，并引入一种仍保留乡村生活表象的市场导向型土地利用方式。然而，最终人们迁往不断扩张的城市，为巴西的大豆和哥伦比亚的油棕等资本密集型作物让路。我们得出结论，个体化“供应链”的概念在处理此类更广泛的动态时是短视的。相反，有效的可持续性干预措施需要解决地方脆弱性问题，并投资于能够成功对冲毁林驱动因素的经济替代方案。
title: Beyond the “supply chain” framing: Cattle ranching as a vanishing mediator of deforestation and dispossession in the Brazilian and Colombian Amazon
title_zh: 超越“供应链”框架：养牛业作为巴西亚马孙与哥伦比亚亚马孙地区森林砍伐和土地掠夺的消逝中介

abstract: The existing literature has documented the positive impact of standards harmonization in the importing country on trade, but it has not examined whether better institutional quality in exporting countries helps enhance the gains from this harmonization. Combining disaggregated trade data with data on maximum residue levels (MRLs) in pesticides, we exploit the EU's 2008 harmonization of pesticides MRLs to study the impact of institutional quality in non‐EU exporting countries on EU imports of horticultural products from these countries over 2005–2014 in a structural gravity framework. We find that multiple dimensions of institutional quality—government effectiveness, regulatory quality and rule of law, which reflect institutional capacity to implement and enforce harmonized standards and ensure transparency, and control of corruption that fosters trust between trading partners—enhance the positive impact of harmonization on the probability of exporting to the EU. However, a similar effect on export value is found to be inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 现有文献已证实进口国标准协调对贸易的积极影响，但尚未考察出口国制度质量是否有助于增强这种协调带来的收益。结合细分贸易数据与农药最大残留限量（MRLs）数据，我们利用欧盟2008年农药MRLs协调政策，在结构引力模型框架下，研究了2005—2014年间非欧盟出口国制度质量对欧盟从这些国家进口园艺产品的影响。研究发现，制度质量的多个维度——政府效能、监管质量和法治水平，这些反映制度能力以实施和执行协调标准并确保透明度，以及控制腐败以促进贸易伙伴间信任——均能增强协调对向欧盟出口概率的积极影响。然而，对出口价值的类似影响则未得到明确结论。
title: Standards Harmonization and Institutional Quality in Exporting Countries
title_zh: 标准协调与出口国制度质量

abstract: Cognition is likely to be important for job search, but its role is not yet well understood. We study an online field experiment with jobseekers registered at the Swiss public employment services. Participants were randomly assigned to an online cognitive training program designed to strengthen core cognitive abilities and transversal cognitive abilities relevant for job search. Combining administrative and survey data on employment and earnings, we find that access to cognitive training substantially increases employment rates and earnings while reducing reliance on transfer income. In a simple search model, these findings could arise when cognition improves search effectiveness leading to lower search effort but higher chances of employment.
abstract_zh: 认知在求职过程中可能扮演重要角色，但其作用尚未得到充分理解。我们针对在瑞士公共就业服务机构注册的求职者开展了一项在线实地实验。参与者被随机分配至一项旨在强化核心认知能力及与求职相关的横向认知能力的在线认知训练项目。结合行政与调查数据，涵盖就业与收入情况，我们发现获得认知训练显著提高了就业率和收入，同时减少了对转移性收入的依赖。在一个简单搜索模型中，这些发现可能源于认知提升增强了搜索效率，从而降低了搜索努力但提高了就业机会。
title: Cognitive Training for Jobseekers: Evidence from a Randomized Experiment
title_zh: 求职者认知培训：来自随机实验的证据

abstract: The causal impact of information on consumer decision-making has been a prime area of interest for issues including novel food technologies, nutrition, food safety, and food authenticity. Experiments are oftentimes the only way to estimate causal impacts of information, as secondary data lack details on individual-specific information exposure. Response to information is relevant for many policy questions and has been formally integrated into some policy processes, such as those related to provision of nutrition information. However, the standard approach, which exposes participants to information, may provide inaccurate predictions of real-world outcomes. In the real-world, consumers may choose whether to access information, driven by a variety of motives. Forced exposure in experiments may also unintentionally bias results—threatening the internal validity of the design—by signaling the information’s importance to participants. This study investigates how different methods of presenting information impact both the internal and external validity of research designs. Participants were randomized to one of four conditions: information exposure, opt out to bypass information, opt in to access information, and a no-information control. Our findings indicate that the information presentation method has large impacts on external validity, demonstrated by significant differences in results across conditions. Information provision mode also yields significant, though smaller, impacts on internal validity among the subset of participants who accessed the information. In the study, participants are exposed to information about honey fraud, a topic that is both present in general media and of concern for the beekeeping industry globally.
abstract_zh: 信息对消费者决策的因果影响一直是新型食品技术、营养、食品安全及食品真实性等议题中的核心研究领域。由于二手数据缺乏个体特定信息暴露的细节，实验往往成为估计信息因果影响的唯一途径。对信息的反应与众多政策问题相关，并已被正式纳入某些政策流程，例如与营养信息提供相关的政策。然而，标准方法——即让参与者暴露于信息——可能对现实世界结果的预测不够准确。在现实情境中，消费者可能出于多种动机选择是否获取信息。实验中的强制暴露也可能通过向参与者暗示信息的重要性，无意中引入偏差，从而威胁设计的内在有效性。本研究探讨了不同信息呈现方式如何影响研究设计的内在和外在有效性。参与者被随机分配到四种条件之一：信息暴露、选择退出以绕过信息、选择加入以获取信息，以及无信息对照组。我们的研究结果表明，信息呈现方式对外在有效性有显著影响，各条件间结果存在显著差异。信息提供模式对获取信息的参与者子集的内在有效性也产生了显著但较小的影响。在本研究中，参与者接触到的信息涉及蜂蜜欺诈，这一话题既常见于大众媒体，也是全球养蜂业关注的焦点。
title: Implications of information presentation mode for internal and external validity in consumer experiments
title_zh: 信息呈现方式对消费者实验中内部与外部效度的影响

abstract: Local policies like high-occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane exemptions play an important role in encouraging electric vehicle (EV) adoption, a key component of climate programs. Using tract-level vehicle registrations and detailed data on HOV lane openings from 2012 to 2024, we study the causal effect of HOV policies on EV adoption in California. We find that HOV exemptions significantly increased EV uptake, with effects that were stronger in later years as EV technology and markets advanced. The impact is also greater in more congested areas with longer commutes and concentrated in higher-income tracts, highlighting both the effectiveness and distributional implications of HOV incentives.
abstract_zh: 地方性政策如高占用率车辆（HOV）车道豁免在鼓励电动汽车（EV）采用方面发挥着重要作用，这是气候项目的关键组成部分。利用2012年至2024年间的人口普查区级车辆注册数据及HOV车道开放的详细资料，我们研究了HOV政策对加利福尼亚州电动汽车采用的因果效应。研究发现，HOV豁免显著促进了电动汽车的普及，且随着电动汽车技术和市场的进步，这一效应在后期年份更为显著。此外，该影响在交通拥堵更严重、通勤时间更长的地区更为突出，并集中于高收入区域，这既凸显了HOV激励措施的有效性，也揭示了其分配效应。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Beyond the early era of EVs: Evidence from the staggered rollout of the HOV lane network in California
title_zh: 超越电动汽车早期时代：来自加州HOV车道网络分阶段推出的证据

abstract: The holdout problem presents a pervasive challenge in situations that require the assembly of independently controlled assets, where due to complementarity the combined whole is worth more than the sum of its parts. One avenue for addressing holdout problems involves contingent contracts, where agreements are conditional upon reaching a predetermined threshold. This paper reports an experiment to investigate a new refund bonus contingent mechanism, in which asset owners who agree to participate (e.g., sell their asset) receive a bonus payment if the required threshold for project success is not met. The refund bonus eliminates failure equilibria and improves the frequency of successfully reaching the threshold in the symmetric mixed strategy equilibrium. In the experiment, individual asset holders choose each round whether to accept an offer to sell. Multiple owners must accept for the (contingent) sale to materialize, and holdout owners who do not sell can earn more, so the game has the strategic incentives of a volunteer’s dilemma. The data show that the bonus mechanism increases agreements to sell, the frequency of successful projects, and efficiency. By the second half of the experimental sessions, the total number of sales is 35 percent higher and the threshold is met nearly twice as often with the bonus than without.
abstract_zh: 搁置问题在需要整合独立控制资产的场景中普遍存在，由于互补性，整体价值超过各部分之和。解决搁置问题的一个途径是采用条件合同，即协议以达成预定门槛为条件。本文通过实验研究了一种新的退款奖金条件机制，在该机制中，同意参与（如出售其资产）的资产所有者，若项目成功所需门槛未达成，将获得一笔奖金支付。退款奖金消除了失败均衡，并在对称混合策略均衡中提高了成功达到门槛的频率。实验中，个体资产持有者每轮选择是否接受出售要约。多个所有者必须接受才能使（条件）销售实现，而未出售的搁置所有者能获得更多收益，因此该博弈具有志愿者困境的战略激励。数据显示，奖金机制增加了出售协议的数量、成功项目的频率及效率。在实验后半段，有奖金时的总销售数量比无奖金时高出35%，达到门槛的频率几乎是后者的两倍。
title: JUE Insight: Breaking ground: Can refund bonuses solve the holdout problem?
title_zh: 洞察专栏：破土动工：退款奖金能否解决“钉子户”问题？

abstract: Minimum price floors are a common but understudied instrument for regulating industrial land markets in developing economies. We exploit China’s 2009 adjustment of minimum industrial land prices, which lowered the minimum land price in some counties and raised it in others. Combining parcel-level land transactions with county characteristics in a difference-in-differences design, we find a striking asymmetry: easing counties experienced a 9.15% decline in industrial land prices and a 23.12% expansion in transferred area, whereas tightening counties showed no detectable change. The asymmetry reflects the floor’s initial binding status: it was binding in easing counties, where competition for mobile manufacturing capital pushed prices down and expanded land supply, but non-binding in tightening counties, where the raised floor either stayed below market prices or was offset through rebates and subsidies. Easing counties also gained 15.53% more large-scale industrial enterprises relative to the sample mean and 7.90% in fiscal revenue, yet new land sales concentrated in low- and medium-low-tech, land-intensive sectors, a pattern that persisted through 2022 with no shift toward higher-tech industries. Relaxing a binding industrial land price floor thus brings short-run gains in firm entry and fiscal revenue but leaves these counties specialized in low-tech industries, consistent with race-to-the-bottom competition operating through industrial land pricing.
abstract_zh: 最低价格下限是发展中经济体规范工业用地市场中常见但研究不足的工具。我们利用中国2009年对工业用地最低价格的调整，该调整降低了一些县的最低地价，同时提高了其他县的最低地价。结合地块层面的土地交易与县级特征，采用双重差分设计，我们发现了一个显著的不对称性：放宽限制的县工业用地价格下降了9.15%，转让面积扩大了23.12%，而收紧限制的县则未观察到明显变化。这种不对称性反映了初始最低价格下限的约束状态：在放宽限制的县，最低价格具有约束力，对流动制造业资本的竞争压低了价格并扩大了土地供应；而在收紧限制的县，最低价格不具约束力，提高后的下限要么仍低于市场价格，要么通过回扣和补贴被抵消。放宽限制的县相对于样本均值还新增了15.53%的大型工业企业，财政收入增加了7.90%，但新增土地销售集中在低技术及中低技术、土地密集型行业，这一模式持续至2022年，并未向高技术产业转变。因此，放宽具有约束力的工业用地最低价格下限在短期内带来了企业进入和财政收入的增长，但使这些县长期专注于低技术产业，这与通过工业用地定价进行的逐底竞争现象相符。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Race-to-the-bottom dynamics in industrial land pricing: Asymmetric effects of China’s 2009 price floor adjustment policy
title_zh: 中国工业用地定价中的竞次动态：2009年价格下限调整政策的非对称效应

abstract: Abstract Since the pioneering work of Lizzeri and Persico (2001), it has been well known that, in winner-take-all systems, office-motivated politicians may favor targeted redistribution over the provision of public goods. Motivated by the possibility that similar incentives may arise even in small organizations, we examine a policy proposal to revise a journal-ranking system in a medium-sized Economics Department. At the same time, a majority of faculty members signed a petition on an unrelated issue publicly supporting the department’s governance. Using individual publication records, we analyze whether the distributional consequences of the proposed reform were systematically related to such support. We find that faculty members who signed the petition were significantly more likely to benefit from the initial proposal, while this association became considerably weaker after an open departmental discussion and a subsequent revision of the proposal. The observed pattern is consistent with theories emphasizing distributive incentives and the disciplining role of transparency in collective decision-making though alternative readings of the revision cannot be excluded.
abstract_zh: 自Lizzeri和Persico（2001）的开创性工作以来，众所周知，在赢者通吃的制度下，以职位为导向的政治家可能更倾向于针对性的再分配，而非公共品的提供。鉴于类似激励可能在小规模组织中也出现的可能性，我们考察了一项旨在修订某中等规模经济系期刊排名制度的政策提案。与此同时，该系多数教员签署了一份请愿书，就一项无关事宜公开支持系里的治理。利用个人发表记录，我们分析了拟议改革的分配后果是否与这种支持存在系统性关联。我们发现，签署请愿书的教员在初始提案中显著更可能受益，而在经过系内公开讨论及提案修订后，这一关联显著减弱。观察到的模式与强调分配激励及透明度在集体决策中约束作用的理论相符，尽管对修订过程的其他解读亦无法排除。
title: Electoral incentives when the stakes are low: a case study from an economics department
title_zh: 低风险下的选举激励：经济学系的案例研究

abstract: We estimate short-run electricity demand responses to price changes for Norwegian households from 2023 to 2025, using continental solar and wind forecasts, and hydrological inflow to instrument supply-driven price variation. The presence of several instruments for the price changes allows us to explicitly test the margins at which substitution happens. Households’ electricity substitution is real but coarse: households mostly choose between day and night consumption with a price elasticity of 0.073. Substitution across hours within these blocks, or across days, is more limited.
abstract_zh: 我们利用大陆太阳能和风能预测以及水文流入作为供给驱动价格变动的工具变量，估算了2023年至2025年挪威家庭对电价变化的短期电力需求响应。由于存在多个价格变动工具，我们能够明确检验替代发生的边际。家庭的电力替代是实际存在但较为粗略的：家庭主要在日间和夜间消费之间进行选择，价格弹性为0.073。在这些时段内或跨日的小时间替代则更为有限。
title: The Power of Substitution: Short-Run Electricity Demand Flexibility
title_zh: 替代的力量：短期电力需求弹性

abstract: This study examines the effect of central bank digital currency (CBDC) on corporate risk-taking. Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2017 to 2023, we exploit the pilot rollout of China’s CBDC(e-CNY) as a quasi-natural experiment and implement a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) design. The results show that CBDC significantly increases corporate risk-taking, and this finding remains robust to a range of tests. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the effect is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises (non-SOEs) and firms with higher institutional ownership. Mechanism analyses suggest that CBDC operates by alleviating agency problems and financing constraints, which enhances firms’ risk-taking propensity and capacity. The study further documents that the increased corporate risk-taking associated with CBDC is associated with higher firm value and total factor productivity ( TFP ). These findings extend the literature on the economic consequences of CBDC and the determinants of corporate risk-taking, while offering useful implications for its broader promotion and application.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中央银行数字货币（CBDC）对企业风险承担的影响。利用2017至2023年中国A股上市公司数据，我们将中国CBDC（数字人民币）的试点推广视为准自然实验，并采用多期双重差分（DID）设计。结果显示，CBDC显著提升了企业风险承担水平，且这一发现在一系列检验中保持稳健。异质性分析表明，该效应在非国有企业（non-SOEs）及机构持股比例较高的企业中更为显著。机制分析揭示，CBDC通过缓解代理问题和融资约束发挥作用，从而增强企业的风险承担意愿与能力。研究进一步指出，与CBDC相关的企业风险承担增加与企业价值及全要素生产率（TFP）的提升相关联。这些发现拓展了关于CBDC经济后果及企业风险承担决定因素的文献，同时为其更广泛的推广与应用提供了有益启示。

abstract: Between the seventeenth and twentieth centuries, billions of cowries arrived in West Africa, leaving one of the few quantitative traces available for historians to measure the Atlantic trade's impact on the precolonial market economy. Yet, current estimates substantially underestimate the volume of cowry imports. Drawing on unexplored and underutilized sources, most notably French records, this article presents a new annual time series of cowry imports into West Africa between 1650 and 1905. This series reframes three long‐standing debates. First, contrary to arguments that the slave trade's negative economic impacts were already evident in its early phases, cowry imports grew as the slave trade progressed. Second, by reconstructing the nominal cowry stock, the article shows that the end of the slave trade in a context without a clear alternative caused a lasting contraction of the market economy. Third, the interplay between cowry and coin imports challenges the influential ‘great inflation’ thesis by showing that the region absorbed much larger currency inflows than previously assumed. Together, these findings reveal a highly responsive but exposed monetary system that alternated between rapid growth and deep depressions, a pattern that shaped the Atlantic trade's long‐run economic impact in West Africa.
abstract_zh: 在十七至二十世纪之间，数十亿枚贝币抵达西非，为历史学家衡量大西洋贸易对前殖民时期市场经济的影响留下了少数可量化的痕迹之一。然而，现有的估算严重低估了贝币进口的规模。本文利用未被探索和未被充分利用的资料，尤其是法国档案，构建了1650年至1905年间西非贝币进口的新的年度时间序列。这一序列重新审视了三个长期存在的争论。首先，与奴隶贸易的负面经济影响在其早期阶段已显而易见的论点相反，贝币进口随奴隶贸易的推进而增长。其次，通过重建名义贝币存量，本文表明，在缺乏明确替代方案的情境下，奴隶贸易的终结导致了市场经济的持续收缩。第三，贝币与铸币进口之间的相互作用挑战了颇具影响力的“大通胀”论点，表明该地区吸收的货币流入远超先前假设。综合来看，这些发现揭示了一个高度敏感但脆弱的货币体系，它在快速增长与深度萧条之间交替，这一模式塑造了大西洋贸易对西非的长期经济影响。
title: Atlantic trade and the West African market economy: New evidence from cowry imports, 1650–1905
title_zh: 大西洋贸易与西非市场经济：来自贝壳货币进口的新证据（1650–1905）

abstract: I investigate how local commodity booms impact regional manufacturing in Colombia. I build a multisectoral economic geography model with industry linkages where states trade domestically and internationally. I quantify the spatial spillovers to manufacturing under several local resource boom scenarios, finding three key results. First, states that have both high domestic and international market access tend to see an increase in their manufacturing activity under booms, while less-connected states see a decline. Second, domestic trade and industry linkages can amplify or reduce these manufacturing spillovers. Third, international trade is the main determinant of the spatial spillovers to manufacturing. I also find that local commodity booms produce four patterns: (i) they crowd out manufacturing activity in the state where the boom occurs, (ii) their spatial spillovers to manufacturing change when I eliminate labor mobility frictions, (iii) they increase production costs in manufacturing sectors, and (iv) they induce worker reallocation across sectors. My findings show that geography, trade, and industry linkages crucially determine how commodity booms shape regional industrialization in developing nations.
abstract_zh: 我研究了地方大宗商品繁荣如何影响哥伦比亚的区域制造业。我构建了一个包含产业关联的多部门经济地理模型，其中各州在国内和国际上进行贸易。我量化了几种地方资源繁荣情景下对制造业的空间溢出效应，发现了三个关键结果。首先，在国内和国际市场准入方面均较高的州，在繁荣时期往往会出现制造业活动的增长，而连通性较差的州则会出现下降。其次，国内贸易和产业关联可以放大或缩小这些制造业溢出效应。第三，国际贸易是决定制造业空间溢出效应的主要因素。我还发现，地方大宗商品繁荣产生了四种模式：（i）它们挤出了繁荣发生州的制造业活动，（ii）当我消除劳动力流动摩擦时，其对制造业的空间溢出效应发生变化，（iii）它们提高了制造业部门的生产成本，以及（iv）它们引发了工人跨部门的重新配置。我的研究结果表明，地理、贸易和产业关联在决定大宗商品繁荣如何塑造发展中国家区域工业化方面至关重要。
title: The geography of commodity booms
title_zh: 大宗商品繁荣的地理分布

abstract: This paper examines whether Aid for Trade promotes foreign direct investment using bilateral panel data over 2005–2019. Conventional estimators show mixed results across donors, with no significant effects for Japanese aid. To address potential selection bias, we employ a Bartik‐style instrumental variable exploiting donor sectoral specialization and recipient revealed needs. The 2SLS estimates reveal substantial heterogeneity. Only Japanese AfT demonstrates strong causal effects, while other donors show no significant relationships when instrumented. The contrast between conventional and IV estimates suggests Japan systematically targets recipients with lower FDI potential, creating negative selection bias that masks true effects in conventional estimators. These findings highlight the importance of addressing endogeneity in aid effectiveness research and suggest donor strategies shape both aid allocation and outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2005年至2019年的双边面板数据，考察了“贸易援助”是否促进了外国直接投资。传统估计方法在不同捐助国间显示出混合结果，对日本援助未发现显著效应。为应对潜在的选择性偏差，我们采用了基于巴蒂克风格的工具变量，利用捐助国的部门专业化及受援国的显性需求。两阶段最小二乘估计揭示了显著的异质性。仅日本的贸易援助展现出强烈的因果效应，而其他捐助国在工具变量法下未显示出显著关系。传统估计与工具变量估计之间的对比表明，日本系统性地瞄准了外国直接投资潜力较低的受援国，造成了负向选择性偏差，在传统估计方法中掩盖了真实效应。这些发现强调了在援助有效性研究中处理内生性的重要性，并表明捐助国策略同时塑造了援助分配及其结果。
title: Selection Bias in Aid Effectiveness: Evidence From Aid for Trade and Foreign Direct Investment
title_zh: 援助有效性中的选择偏差：来自贸易援助与外国直接投资的证据

abstract: We study how the quasi-random assignment of MBA students to different peer groups shapes their homophily by gender and ethnicity. We show that students form substantially more cross-trait friendships within small groups than in the broader MBA cohort. We then decompose homophily into the contributions of peer-group composition, preferences, and directed search. Directed search, in which students approach peers with particular characteristics, can substantially amplify even weak preferences for same-trait friends. Survey evidence indicates only weak same-trait preferences but strong same-trait bias in approach decisions. Consistent with this pattern, structural estimates imply that directed search accounts for much of overall homophily. This result helps explain why homophily is lower in small groups, where directed search is muted, and suggests that homophily can be reduced through peer-group design.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了MBA学生被准随机分配到不同同伴群体如何塑造其基于性别和种族的同质性。我们表明，学生在小群体内形成的跨特质友谊显著多于在更广泛的MBA群体中。随后，我们将同质性分解为同伴群体构成、偏好和定向搜索的贡献。定向搜索，即学生主动接触具有特定特征的同伴，即使对同特质朋友的偏好较弱，也能大幅放大这种偏好。调查证据显示，同特质偏好仅较弱，但在接触决策中存在强烈的同特质偏见。与此模式一致，结构估计表明，定向搜索解释了整体同质性的大部分。这一结果有助于解释为何在小群体中同质性较低，因为定向搜索在此受到抑制，并提示通过同伴群体设计可以降低同质性。
title: Small-Group Interactions Reduce Homophily by Muting Directed Search
title_zh: 小组互动通过抑制定向搜索减少同质性

abstract: Government regulation of the banking sector is pervasive, making it difficult to empirically analyze when banks would voluntarily choose to issue equity if there were no minimum requirements on capital adequacy. A unique historical setting occurred in the late nineteenth-century United Kingdom when joint-stock banks were free to choose their capital structures. We show that during this era, banks were willing to issue equity as part of restructuring processes, but were reluctant to do so on a regular basis to offset increases in liabilities. We find that large issues of uncalled capital were made as a replacement for unlimited liability, and this uncalled capital continued to restrain risk taking as shown by an analysis of bank loan books. Banks were also willing to issue stock to finance mergers and acquisitions, but this was generally just used to absorb the equity of target banks so did not increase aggregate paid-up capital. Equity issuance did not keep pace with deposit growth, leading to the erosion of capital adequacy over the long run.
abstract_zh: 政府对银行业的监管无处不在，这使得在缺乏最低资本充足率要求的情况下，难以实证分析银行何时会自愿选择发行股本。19世纪末的英国提供了一个独特的历史背景，当时股份制银行可以自由选择其资本结构。我们表明，在那个时代，银行愿意在重组过程中发行股本，但不愿定期这样做以抵消负债的增加。我们发现，大量未缴资本的发行是为了替代无限责任，而这种未缴资本继续约束着风险承担，这一点通过对银行贷款账簿的分析得以证实。银行也愿意发行股票以资助并购活动，但这通常仅用于吸收目标银行的股本，因此并未增加总实缴资本。股本发行未能跟上存款增长的步伐，导致长期资本充足率逐渐侵蚀。
title: Free to Choose: Bank Capital in Britain, 1878-1939
title_zh: 自由选择：英国银行资本，1878-1939

abstract: This paper models fertility as the outcome of gender‐biased technological progress interacting with endogenous social norms governing childcare. When rising female wages outpace norm adjustment, the inherited norm makes reallocating childcare toward fathers costly, so mothers bear a disproportionate burden and the shadow price of children rises. In cross‐country data, fertility falls faster where women's relative standing rises, especially where norms are tighter or more rigid. Calibrated to South Korea (1976–2016), the model shows that strong, slow‐adjusting norms deepen the decline. Despite smaller short‐run effects, male childcare subsidies yield larger long‐run gains than female subsidies by accelerating convergence to egalitarian norms.
abstract_zh: 本文将生育率建模为性别偏见技术进步与内生社会规范（管理育儿责任）相互作用的结果。当女性工资增长超过规范调整速度时，继承的规范使得将育儿责任重新分配给父亲变得代价高昂，因此母亲承担不成比例的负担，孩子的影子价格上升。跨国数据显示，在女性相对地位提升较快的地方，生育率下降更快，尤其是在规范更严格或更僵化的地区。以韩国（1976-2016年）为校准对象，模型表明，强大且调整缓慢的规范加深了生育率下降。尽管短期效应较小，但男性育儿补贴通过加速向平等规范的收敛，比女性补贴带来更大的长期收益。
title: The Dynamics of Gender Norms and Fertility Decline
title_zh: 性别规范动态与生育率下降

abstract: We study how the U.S.-China trade war affected manufacturing activity in third countries using a novel plant-level dataset covering millions of establishments in 50 major economies, including aliates of more than 200,000 multinational enterprises (MNEs). Combining establishment-level data with detailed tariff information, we estimate the effects of U.S. and Chinese punitive bilateral output and input tari s on sales, employment, and establishments across countries, industries, and stages of production. We find that third-country effects of the trade war are highly heterogeneous and largely offsetting, yielding moderately negative net effects overall. Most of the adjustment is driven by multinational enterprises reallocating activity across affiliate networks, while domestic firms respond much less.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项涵盖50个主要经济体中数百万家企业的新型工厂级数据集，包括超过20万家跨国企业（MNEs）的关联公司，研究了中美贸易战如何影响第三国的制造业活动。结合工厂级数据与详细的关税信息，我们估算了美国和中国惩罚性双边产出及投入关税对各国、各行业及各生产阶段销售、就业和工厂数量的影响。我们发现，贸易战对第三国的影响高度异质且大体相互抵消，总体净效应为适度负面。大部分调整由跨国企业在其关联网络间重新配置活动所驱动，而国内企业的反应则相对较小。

abstract: Does corporate authorship increase or decrease deceptive conduct in science? Commercial interests are often viewed as a threat to scientific integrity. Yet when firms build on their science in downstream innovation, fraudulent findings can derail costly development, creating private incentives to produce reliable evidence. We test this logic in Alzheimer’s research, using inappropriate image duplication as an observable marker of deceptive conduct. Combining AI-based detection with manual validation, we document a rising incidence of data manipulation. Such cases are nearly absent in corporate-authored papers and less frequent in academic-industry collaborations, but only when firms exercise meaningful control over the production of evidence. The reduction in problematic duplications is largest when firms are likely to build on the results and in settings where deceptive conduct is more prevalent. However, this difference disappears when research concerns drugs already commercialized by the authoring firm. These findings recast the role of commercial interests in science: they can undermine integrity when legitimating existing products, but strengthen it when firms need solid evidence to build on.
abstract_zh: 企业作者身份是增加还是减少了科学中的欺骗行为？商业利益常被视为对科学诚信的威胁。然而，当企业在下游创新中依托自身科研成果时，欺诈性发现可能使昂贵的研发进程偏离轨道，从而产生私人激励去产出可靠的证据。我们在阿尔茨海默病研究中检验了这一逻辑，以不当图像重复作为欺骗行为的可观察标记。结合基于人工智能的检测与人工验证，我们记录了数据操纵现象日益增多的趋势。此类情况在企业作者署名的论文中几乎不存在，在学术-产业合作中亦较少出现，但前提是企业对证据生产过程施加了实质性控制。当企业很可能基于研究结果进行后续开发，以及欺骗行为更为普遍的背景下，问题性重复的减少最为显著。然而，当研究涉及作者企业已商业化的药物时，这一差异消失。这些发现重新诠释了商业利益在科学中的作用：当用于为现有产品正名时，商业利益可能损害诚信；但当企业需要可靠证据以支撑后续开发时，商业利益则能强化诚信。
title: Deceptive Science Maps: Organizational Affiliation and Data Manipulation in Alzheimer's Research
title_zh: 欺骗性科学地图：阿尔茨海默病研究中的组织隶属关系与数据操纵

abstract: Uncontrolled urban expansion places increasing pressure on natural resources and poses a significant threat to agricultural production. The loss of agricultural land negatively affects food security and ecosystem services, while rising carbon emissions further exacerbate environmental challenges. In this context, the protection of fertile agricultural lands surrounding cities is critical for sustainable food production. Urban agriculture has emerged as an alternative approach that supports local food production, economic viability, and environmental sustainability. This study examines the suitability of agricultural lands located on the urban fringe of Erzurum for urban agriculture as a response to urban sprawl. The study area, covering selected neighbourhoods in the western part of Erzurum, was divided into 1 × 1 km grid cells. Spatial analyses were conducted for each grid cell based on seven main parameters and twenty-three sub-criteria. An agricultural suitability synthesis map was generated according to the cumulative impact scores derived from these parameters. Rather than limiting the analysis to suitability identification, the spatial results were translated into eight planning-oriented urban agriculture typologies targeting different user groups by integrating suitability outcomes with existing land-use and functional characteristics. The findings indicate that 848 ha of land in Erzurum’s urban periphery exhibit very high suitability for urban agriculture, while 1385 ha demonstrate high suitability. Overall, the study demonstrates that urban agriculture can function as a strategic land-use policy instrument by linking spatial suitability assessment with typology-based planning approaches, thereby supporting peri-urban land protection and guiding statutory planning decisions in secondary cities such as Erzurum.
abstract_zh: 不受控制的城市扩张对自然资源施加了日益增长的压力，并对农业生产构成了重大威胁。农地流失对粮食安全和生态系统服务产生负面影响，而碳排放的上升进一步加剧了环境挑战。在此背景下，保护城市周边肥沃农田对于可持续粮食生产至关重要。城市农业已成为一种支持本地粮食生产、经济可行性和环境可持续性的替代途径。本研究考察了埃尔祖鲁姆城市边缘区农地作为应对城市蔓延的城市农业适宜性。研究区域覆盖埃尔祖鲁姆西部选定的社区，被划分为1×1公里的网格单元。基于七项主要参数和二十三项子标准，对每个网格单元进行了空间分析。根据这些参数得出的累积影响得分，生成了农业适宜性综合图。分析并未局限于适宜性识别，而是通过将适宜性结果与现有土地利用和功能特征相结合，将空间结果转化为面向不同用户群体的八种规划导向型城市农业类型。研究结果表明，埃尔祖鲁姆城市边缘区有848公顷土地对城市农业表现出极高的适宜性，另有1385公顷土地表现出高适宜性。总体而言，本研究证明，通过将空间适宜性评估与基于类型的规划方法相结合，城市农业可以作为一种战略性的土地利用政策工具，从而支持城郊土地保护，并指导埃尔祖鲁姆等次级城市的法定规划决策。
title: Urban agriculture as a land-use policy instrument for protecting peri-urban agricultural land: A grid-based analysis from Erzurum, Türkiye
title_zh: 城市农业作为保护城郊农业用地的土地利用政策工具：来自土耳其埃尔祖鲁姆的基于网格的分析

abstract: This paper studies how reducing the cost differential between permanent and temporary contracts affects firms’ use of each contract type. We analyze a 1997 Spanish reform that lowered non-wage labor costs for new open-ended (OE) contracts for workers under 30 and over 45, while leaving short-term (ST) contracts unaffected. Exploiting sectoral exposure and age-based discontinuities, we show that firms substitute strongly from ST to OE contracts for young workers but respond little for older workers. We find partial wage incidence of the subsidy on directly affected permanent jobs. The implied elasticity of substitution between ST and OE contracts is 6.5 for workers below age 30 and close to zero for workers above age 45. We also document that young workers’ wages rise in unsubsidized ST jobs consistent with the expansion of OE employment strengthening their outside options. Overall, the results reveal sharp age asymmetries in contract substitution. They suggest that monetary incentives can facilitate transitions from temporary to permanent employment for young workers, but are less effective for workers above age 45.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了降低永久合同与临时合同之间的成本差异如何影响企业对各类合同的使用。我们分析了1997年西班牙的一项改革，该改革降低了30岁以下及45岁以上新签无固定期限（OE）合同的非工资劳动力成本，而短期（ST）合同则未受影响。利用行业暴露程度和基于年龄的断点，我们表明，对于年轻工人，企业会显著从ST合同转向OE合同，但对年长工人的反应则较小。我们发现补贴对直接受影响的永久性工作岗位存在部分工资传导效应。对于30岁以下的工人，ST与OE合同之间的替代弹性估计为6.5，而对于45岁以上的工人，该弹性接近于零。我们还记录了年轻工人在未获补贴的ST岗位中工资上升的现象，这与OE就业扩张增强了他们的外部选择权相一致。总体而言，研究结果揭示了合同替代中显著的年龄不对称性。这表明，货币激励可以促进年轻工人从临时就业转向永久就业，但对于45岁以上的工人效果则较为有限。
title: Escaping temporary traps? Evidence from age-based incentives to permanent employment
title_zh: 摆脱临时陷阱？基于年龄的永久就业激励证据

abstract: In the African Financial Community (CFA) franc zones, a credible euro peg coexists with external debt denominated largely in U.S. dollars: euro–dollar fluctuations, exogenous to these small economies, directly raise the domestic-currency burden of debt. Panel regressions show that such depreciations raise sovereign default intensity by roughly 9%. In these same high-default years, consumption does not fall—evidence against the insurance motive of standard default models. I explain both facts by extending the partial default framework of Arellano et al. (2023) with foreign-currency debt, exogenous exchange rate shocks, and government heterogeneity. Exogeneity changes the nature of default: governments default not for insurance but opportunistically, exploiting the valuation gap between the higher debt burden and the higher revenue from new borrowing, generating a short-run rise in consumption. A policy counterfactual finds leaving for a self-managed dollar peg welfare-neutral on the financial side: opportunistic default insures the mismatch so effectively that a country profits from devaluations whatever their source, so the arrangement’s value lies not in shielding the debt but in the exogenous-devaluation environment that makes default opportunistic.
abstract_zh: 在非洲金融共同体（CFA）法郎区，可信的欧元盯住汇率制度与主要以美元计价的外部债务并存：欧元兑美元汇率的波动，对这些小型经济体而言是外生的，直接加重了国内货币计价的债务负担。面板回归显示，此类贬值会使主权违约强度上升约9%。而在这些高违约年份中，消费并未下降——这与标准违约模型中的保险动机相悖。我通过扩展Arellano等人（2023）的部分违约框架，引入外币债务、外生汇率冲击及政府异质性，来解释这两个事实。外生性改变了违约的本质：政府违约并非出于保险目的，而是机会主义行为，利用更高债务负担与新增借款更高收入之间的估值缺口，从而在短期内推高消费。一项政策反事实分析发现，转向自我管理的美元盯住汇率制度在金融层面福利中性：机会主义违约如此有效地对冲了货币错配，以至于无论贬值源于何种因素，国家都能从中获利，因此该安排的价值不在于保护债务本身，而在于外生贬值环境使违约具有机会主义性质。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Opportunistic Sovereign Default under a Credible Peg
title_zh: 可信盯住汇率制下的机会主义主权违约

abstract: In finite problems comprising objects, cases, and an object- and case-contingent payoff function, we study the comparative statics of the set of undominated objects, meaning those for which there exists no mixture over objects that is superior in every case. We consider both weak and strict dominance (corresponding to different degrees of ‘strictness’ in the definition of superiority). Our main theorem characterises those payoff transformations which robustly expand the not-weakly-dominated and not-strictly-dominated sets: the necessary and sufficient condition is that payoffs be transformed separately across cases, in either a monotone–concave or a constant manner. We apply our results to Pareto frontiers and games.
abstract_zh: 在由对象、情形及依赖于对象与情形的收益函数构成的有限问题中，我们研究了无支配对象集合的比较静态性质，即那些不存在任何在每种情形下均更优的对象混合的对象。我们同时考虑了弱支配与严格支配（对应于“更优”定义中不同程度的“严格性”）。我们的主要定理刻画了那些能够稳健地扩展非弱支配集合与非严格支配集合的收益变换：其必要且充分条件是，收益需按情形分别进行变换，且变换方式要么是单调凹的，要么是恒定的。我们将结果应用于帕累托前沿与博弈中。
title: The comparative statics of dominance
title_zh: 支配地位的比较静态分析

title_zh: 纳粹拘禁中的社会地位与大屠杀幸存

abstract: This paper examines the intergenerational effects of the Food Stamp Program (FSP) on fertility and marriage in the United States. Using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we leverage the initial roll-out of the Food Stamp Program in the 1960s and 1970s to examine the future family formation decisions of individuals born between 1955 and 1981. The results suggest that exposure to the program has different effects on fertility and marriage based on age and gender. For men, increased exposure to the program reduces fertility at older ages, particularly for those from disadvantaged backgrounds, with limited effects on marriage. Among women, we find no statistically significant effects of increased exposure to FSP on fertility and marriage. Our study builds on a growing literature that considers the intergenerational impacts of public policies that increase childhood economic resources.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国食品券计划（FSP）对生育与婚姻的代际影响。利用收入动态面板研究数据，我们借助20世纪60年代和70年代食品券计划的初始推行，探讨了1955年至1981年间出生个体未来的家庭组建决策。结果表明，该计划的暴露程度对生育和婚姻的影响因年龄和性别而异。对于男性而言，增加计划暴露会降低其较大年龄时的生育率，尤其是对来自不利背景的男性，而对婚姻的影响有限。在女性中，我们发现增加FSP暴露对生育和婚姻无统计学上显著的影响。本研究丰富了日益增长的文献，这些文献关注增加童年经济资源的公共政策所产生的代际影响。
title: The intergenerational effect of the Food Stamp Program on marriage and fertility
title_zh: 食品券计划对婚姻与生育的代际影响

abstract: This paper provides direct evidence that shared incarceration can facilitate the formation of post-release criminal partnerships. Using Norwegian administrative data linking prison spells to police case identifiers, we measure network ties through subsequent co-offending. We exploit time-based variation in exposure within facilities by comparing inmate pairs in the same facility who differ only in whether their spells overlapped. Overlap is associated with a 37% increase in five-year co-offending relative to comparable non-overlapping pairs, robust to extensive controls and timing-based restrictions. Effects are stronger in environments and for pairs where interaction is plausibly more intense, highlighting network formation as a plausible mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了直接证据，表明共同监禁经历可能促进释放后犯罪伙伴关系的形成。利用挪威行政数据，将监狱服刑期与警方案件标识符相链接，我们通过后续共同犯罪来衡量网络联系。我们利用设施内接触时间上的变化，比较同一设施中仅在服刑期是否重叠上有所不同的囚犯配对。与可比的非重叠配对相比，重叠配对五年内共同犯罪率增加了37%，这一结果在广泛的控制变量和基于时间的限制条件下依然稳健。在互动强度可能更高的环境及配对中，效应更为显著，凸显了网络形成作为一种合理解释机制。
title: From prison peers to co-offenders
title_zh: 从狱友到共同犯罪者

abstract: How large is the labour cost saved by AI, and how is it distributed across occupations? Using five waves of the Anthropic Economic Index from January 2025 to February 2026, this column constructs two novel measures from observed AI usage across countries over the world. The labour cost equivalent values the time currently saved by AI at $2.7 trillion annually (3.4% of GDP), concentrated in a small professional enclave in developing economies, with concentration declining in many countries.
abstract_zh: 人工智能节省的劳动力成本规模有多大，其在不同职业间的分布如何？利用2025年1月至2026年2月间五轮Anthropic经济指数数据，本文基于全球各国观察到的AI使用情况，构建了两个新颖的衡量指标。劳动力成本等值将当前AI节省的时间估值每年达2.7万亿美元（占GDP的3.4%），集中于发展中经济体的一个小型专业领域，且在许多国家中，这种集中度正在下降。
title: AI’s gains are large and rising, but unevenly shared
title_zh: 人工智能收益巨大且持续增长，但分配不均

abstract: Autocratic regimes shape what citizens know through censorship and propaganda, but their priorities are rarely observable at scale. This column exploits the 2023 cloning of Russian-language Wikipedia and its subsequent rewriting into Ruwiki, a regime-aligned alternative. Comparing the two 1.9 million-article corpora reveals a coherent editorial intervention legitimising Russia’s aggression, suppressing opposition and criticism of state institutions, and promoting traditional values. Rewriting is far more common than outright deletion, suggesting that modern information control works primarily by changing the meaning of familiar topics rather than making them disappear.
abstract_zh: 专制政权通过审查和宣传塑造公民的认知，但其优先事项在宏观层面往往难以观察。本文利用2023年俄语维基百科的克隆及其随后被改写为亲政权的替代平台Ruwiki这一事件，比较了两个各含190万篇文章的语料库，揭示出一场连贯的编辑干预，旨在为俄罗斯的侵略行为赋予合法性，压制反对声音及对国家机构的批评，并推广传统价值观。改写远比直接删除更为普遍，这表明现代信息控制主要通过改变熟悉话题的含义来运作，而非使其消失。
authors: Ekaterina Zhuravskaya, Ulrich Matter, Ruben Durante, Vladimir Avetian
title: The anatomy of censorship and propaganda: What Russia’s Wikipedia clone reveals about authoritarian information control
title_zh: 审查与宣传的解剖：俄罗斯维基百科克隆版揭示的威权信息控制

abstract: This paper develops a quarterly projection model for Korea with an integrated fiscal block, enabling analysis of monetary-fiscal interactions. The model is validated through historical decompositions and forecast evaluation. Scenario analysis comparing dynamics with and without debt-stabilizing fiscal rules reveals a fundamental trade-off: rules generate short-run procyclicality but prevent permanent debt drift. Without rules, temporary nominal GDP movements cause lasting debt-to-GDP changes. For Korea, facing age-related spending pressures, a medium-term fiscal framework could safeguard sustainability.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含整合财政模块的韩国季度预测模型，用以分析货币与财政政策之间的相互作用。通过历史分解和预测评估对模型进行了验证。情景分析比较了在有无债务稳定财政规则下的动态变化，揭示了一个基本权衡：规则虽引发短期顺周期性，但能防止债务的永久性漂移。若无规则，名义GDP的暂时波动将导致债务与GDP比率的持久变化。鉴于韩国面临与人口老龄化相关的支出压力，采用中期财政框架或可保障可持续性。
authors: Alexander Borodin & Matteo Ghilardi & Tommy Lee & Victoria Petrenko
title: Monetary–Fiscal Policy Interactions in Korea: A QPM-Based Analysis
title_zh: 韩国货币-财政政策互动：基于QPM的分析

abstract: Public debt and wealth concentration have co-moved persistently across advanced economies and historical periods, defying standard theories of wealth inequality, particularly given that rising inequality has coincided with falling real interest rates in recent decades. I develop a stylized Diamond model with household heterogeneity and progressive taxation to formalize how public debt, through its tax burden, endogenously dictates tax progressivity and thereby affects the wealth distribution. In this framework, permanent debt shocks alter tax progressivity depending on the macroeconomic regime, with debt expansions increasing progressivity when interest rates are high but reducing it when interest rates are low. The resulting impact of public debt on wealth inequality is nonlinear in the overall level of the tax burden, disequalizing below a threshold and equalizing above it. Cross-country empirical evidence supports these predictions and shows that public debt is a quantitatively important, and often dominant, driver of postwar wealth inequality, with sizable effects transmitted primarily through the tax burden. These findings establish the distribution of the tax burden as a primary driver of long-run wealth inequality, and public debt as a central mediating channel through which structural shocks, such as population aging or artificial intelligence, propagate to the wealth distribution.
abstract_zh: 公共债务与财富集中度在发达经济体及历史时期中持续同步变动，这挑战了标准的财富不平等理论，尤其是在近几十年不平等加剧的同时实际利率却下降的背景下。我构建了一个包含家庭异质性和累进税制的简化Diamond模型，以形式化说明公共债务如何通过其税收负担内生地决定税收累进性，进而影响财富分配。在此框架下，永久性债务冲击会根据宏观经济体制改变税收累进性：当利率较高时，债务扩张增加累进性；而当利率较低时，则降低累进性。公共债务对财富不平等的影响在总体税收负担水平上呈现非线性特征，低于某一阈值时加剧不平等，高于该阈值时则缓解不平等。跨国经验证据支持这些预测，并表明公共债务是战后财富不平等的一个数量上重要且往往占主导地位的驱动因素，其显著效应主要通过税收负担传导。这些发现确立了税收负担分配作为长期财富不平等的主要驱动因素，以及公共债务作为结构性冲击（如人口老龄化或人工智能）向财富分配传导的核心中介渠道。
title: Public Debt, Wealth Inequality, and the Burden of Taxation
title_zh: 公共债务、财富不平等与税收负担

abstract: This paper presents the IMF’s systemwide stress testing approaches, which cover multiple financial sub-sectors and their clients. Developing these tools is crucial for identifying cross-sector and cross border amplification channels and enhancing policy responses, as recognized by the international financial stability community. The paper reviews classic and modern theories and operational methods for analyzing systemic liquidity risks that impact numerous institutions simultaneously, illustrating how shocks can spread through banks, nonbank financial institutions (NBFIs), and market-based finance via runs, redemptions, margin and collateral calls, fire sales, price dynamics, and disruptions in core markets. It details two base IMF tools—an Excel-based flow-of-funds framework and investment fund liquidity analysis with fire sale and market-impact dynamics—and their application and enhancement within Financial Sector Assessment Programs (FSAPs) across various countries.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了IMF的系统性压力测试方法，这些方法覆盖多个金融子行业及其客户。正如国际金融稳定界所认识到的，开发这些工具对于识别跨部门和跨境放大渠道以及加强政策应对至关重要。本文回顾了分析同时影响众多机构的系统性流动性风险的经典与现代理论及操作方法，阐述了冲击如何通过银行、非银行金融机构（NBFIs）以及基于市场的融资渠道，经由挤兑、赎回、保证金和抵押品追缴、抛售、价格动态以及核心市场中断而传播。文章详细介绍了IMF的两个基础工具——基于Excel的资金流量框架和包含抛售及市场影响动态的投资基金流动性分析——以及它们在各国金融部门评估规划（FSAPs）中的应用与增强。
authors: Ms. Hiroko Oura & Guillaume Arnould & Xiaodan Ding & Pierpaolo Grippa & Mr. Marco Gross & Mr. Dimitrios Laliotis & Mindaugas Leika & Caterina Lepore & Elisa Letizia & Ms. Laura Valderrama & Yuchen Zhang
title: Systemwide Stress Test at the IMF: Integrating Nonbank Financial Intermediary Risks
title_zh: 国际货币基金组织的系统性压力测试：整合非银行金融中介风险

abstract: This paper analyzes a global map of dollar exposures and examines the relationship between net dollar exposures, defined as the difference between dollar assets and liabilities, and covered interest parity (CIP) deviations. We find that the cross-sectional relationship is significantly negative in advanced economies but positive in emerging markets. CIP deviations represent the hedging cost that foreign holders of dollar assets or liabilities incur to manage exchange rate risk. To explain, we develop a model in which the CIP deviations are determined by the demand and the supply side of hedging. The negative correlation in advanced economies can be explained by the variations in hedging demand. Larger net dollar exposures increase the hedging demand, raising hedging costs (reflected as more negative CIP deviations) and producing a negative correlation. In contrast, the positive correlation in emerging markets is explained by the supply side of the hedging market. Limited hedging supply leads to wider CIP deviations (more negative), encouraging firms to borrow in U.S. dollars rather than local currencies, thereby reducing net dollar exposures and generating a positive correlation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了全球美元敞口分布图，并考察了净美元敞口（定义为美元资产与负债之差）与套息平价（CIP）偏离之间的关系。我们发现，在发达经济体中，这一横截面关系显著为负，而在新兴市场中则为正。CIP偏离代表了美元资产或负债的外国持有者为管理汇率风险而产生的对冲成本。为解释这一现象，我们构建了一个模型，其中CIP偏离由对冲需求方和供给方共同决定。发达经济体中的负相关可由对冲需求的变动来解释。较大的净美元敞口增加对冲需求，推高对冲成本（表现为更负的CIP偏离），从而产生负相关关系。相反，新兴市场中的正相关则由对冲市场的供给方解释。有限的对冲供给导致CIP偏离扩大（更负），促使企业以美元而非本币借款，从而减少净美元敞口，并产生正相关关系。
title: Global Dollar Exposure and Its Relationship with CIP Deviations
title_zh: 全球美元敞口及其与CIP偏差的关系

abstract: Starting from Robbins (1952), the literature on experimentation viamulti-armed bandits has wed exploration and exploitation. Nonetheless, in many applications, agents’ exploration and exploitation need not be intertwined: a policymaker may assess new policies different than the status quo; an investor may evaluate projects outside her portfolio. We characterize the optimal experimentation policy when exploration and exploitation are disentangled in the case of Poisson bandits with fully revealing news, considering news structures that allow for arrival of both good and bad news. The optimal policy features complete learning asymptotically, exhibits lots of persistence, but cannot be identified by an index à la Gittins.
abstract_zh: 自Robbins（1952）以来，关于多臂老虎机实验的文献将探索与利用紧密结合。然而，在许多应用中，主体的探索与利用未必需要交织在一起：政策制定者可能评估不同于现状的新政策；投资者可能评估其投资组合之外的项目。我们刻画了在探索与利用分离情形下的最优实验政策，针对具有完全揭示信息的泊松老虎机，并考虑允许好消息与坏消息同时到达的消息结构。最优政策在渐近意义上实现完全学习，表现出显著的持续性，但无法通过吉廷斯式指数加以识别。
title: Disentangling Exploration from Exploitation
title_zh: 区分探索与利用
